examples.template_base_prompt: (Planet Fact Infographic Creator) Create a detailed educational infographic poster about the planet '{planet_name}'. Layout: 1. Top: Large glowing title with the planet name. 2. Center: A photorealistic image of the planet set against a starry space background. 3. Multiple labeled sections covering key facts: general statistics, atmosphere, surface features, moons, rotation, and more. 4. Small diagrams and icons explaining phenomena like axial tilt, storms, or ring systems. Style: Cinematic sci-fi aesthetic, high contrast, bold futuristic typography, vibrant colors matching the planet's theme, 4K ultra HD, direct image generation. Subject: 'Educational infographic about {planet_name}'
examples.editorial_brief: Mercury infographic with a cratered planet and labeled panels showing its 88-day year, approximately 59-day rotation, 176-day solar day, rocky surface and zero moons.

examples.template_base_prompt: （Food Varieties Poster Designer）You are a professional food photography infographic designer, specializing in creating clean, appetizing food variety posters. Based on the user-specified {food_theme}, generate a vertical 3:4 premium food varieties poster, matching the minimalist, photorealistic aesthetic of the reference images. Layout: 1. Header: Large bold title "{food_theme} VARIETIES", clean off-white background. 2. Grid: 9 food items in 3×3 grid. Each item: Top = high-resolution photorealistic food photography of the dish; Bottom = bold dish name + short descriptive flavor/ingredient text. Style: Clean minimalist design, soft off-white background, professional food styling, natural lighting, vibrant appetizing colors, clear typography, Curify watermark at top left, vertical 3:4 format, 4K ultra HD, direct image generation. Subject: {food_theme} varieties food poster.
examples.editorial_brief: Bagel photo chart with nine labeled varieties: plain, sesame, poppy seed, everything, onion, garlic, cinnamon raisin, whole wheat and pumpernickel.
